scripts.plaid:new: node -e "(async()=>{const user=process.env.USER_ID||'demo'; const inst=process.env.INST_ID||'ins_109508'; const name=process.env.INST_NAME||'First Platypus Bank'; const r=await fetch('http://localhost:4001/plaid/sandbox/create-item',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({userId:user,institutionId:inst,institutionName:name})}); console.log(await r.text());})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);});"

scripts.plaid:cursor:reset: node -e "import('./dist/db/prisma.js').then(async ({prisma})=>{const id=process.env.ITEM_ID||process.argv[2];if(!id){console.error('ITEM_ID required');process.exit(1);} await prisma.bankItem.update({where:{id},data:{cursor:null}}); console.log('cursor reset:',id); process.exit(0);});"
scripts.plaid:remove:fake: node -e "import('./dist/db/prisma.js').then(async ({prisma})=>{const itemId=process.env.ITEM_ID||process.argv[2];if(!itemId){console.error('ITEM_ID required');process.exit(1);} const bi=await prisma.bankItem.findUnique({ where:{ id:itemId } }); const tx=await prisma.bankTransaction.findMany({ where:{ account:{ itemId }, removed:false }, select:{ id:true }, take:5 }); const payload={webhook_type:'TRANSACTIONS', webhook_code:'TRANSACTIONS_REMOVED', item_id: bi.plaidItemId, removed_transactions: tx.map(t=>t.id)}; const r=await fetch('http://localhost:4001/plaid/webhook',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(payload)}); console.log('webhook', r.status); console.log(payload); process.exit(0);});"
